contract.note: The distinction between interaction and motor control is reasonable, but the contract uses a plain-reading interpretation to score explicitly qualified language. That exception applies only to firm claims. Identifying unnamed demonstrations with We Robot also limits coverage.

evidence.note: Timely reporting supports human assistance with conversation, drinks and games at We Robot, distinguishing autonomous walking. It does not establish every recent demonstration or quantify commonsense.

Tesla's disclosure confirms some assistance and autonomous walking, balancing and dancing. It limits any inference of total remote control but does not establish who supplied most interactive judgment.

Reporting supports its tentative account of We Robot, while the company disclosure identifies autonomous functions. Neither removes the qualifier or establishes the broader demonstration scope.
